what: The vault the Industry Wire pages read in the browser. The read key is public on purpose: it can read every file and every commit of this vault, and it cannot write. Everything in this vault is therefore public, for ever (a published read key cannot be withdrawn from anyone who has fetched the objects). The write key is held by the agents that run the wire and is not on this site.
named_readers_what: People who agreed, on the date recorded, to be a named reader of the wire while it is a beta: the vault carries a persona in their name and a personal brief for them, both public. The edition page offers a lens for each persona listed here and for no other named person.

named_readers.name: Dinis Cruz
named_readers.how: in writing, in the session that built the wire pages; the site's owner, while the site has few readers
